from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A financial statement line item from a company's report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name this report belongs to")
    line_item_name: str | None = Field(description="The line item name as written in the report")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value for this line item, or None if not reported")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季'")
    balance_type: str | None = Field(description="Whether this is beginning/ending balance or other")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short excerpt from the report containing this value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_line_items: list[FinancialLineItem]
